name: RHD prophylaxis overdue
description: BPG injection past due: last injection plus the interval of the latest prescribed BPG regimen has passed
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, (SELECT CASE rt.code WHEN 'q14_day_bpg' THEN 14 WHEN 'q21_day_bpg' THEN 21 WHEN 'q28_day_bpg' THEN 28 END FROM concept_reference_map m JOIN concept_reference_term rt ON rt.concept_reference_term_id = m.concept_reference_term_id WHERE m.concept_id = o.value_coded AND rt.code IN ('q14_day_bpg','q21_day_bpg','q28_day_bpg') LIMIT 1) AS interval_days FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs later WHERE later.person_id = o.person_id AND later.concept_id = o.concept_id AND later.voided = 0 AND (later.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (later.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND later.obs_id > o.obs_id)))) reg ON reg.person_id = inj.person_id JOIN patient pat ON pat.patient_id = inj.person_id AND pat.voided = 0 WHERE reg.interval_days IS NOT NULL AND DATE(inj.last_injection) + INTERVAL reg.interval_days DAY < CURDATE()

name: RHD lost to follow-up
description: No RHD Consultation Visit or Consultation Update form and no prophylaxis record for 210 days (7 months) in a patient with a prescription. Mirrors ACT 2.0 Needs Prophylaxis Data Red.
criteria: SELECT pat.patient_id FROM patient pat JOIN (SELECT e.patient_id, MAX(e.encounter_datetime) AS last_consult FROM encounter e JOIN form f ON f.form_id = e.form_id WHERE f.uuid IN ('4b063fc7-996f-3001-8500-8940e201be8f', '72ebc67c-f221-3ca2-9494-f5b19ecc60d5') AND e.voided = 0 GROUP BY e.patient_id) con ON con.patient_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT o.person_id, MAX(o.value_datetime) AS last_injection FROM obs o JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE c.uuid = '183fb30e-b861-5b7c-806f-7118a40f2b51' AND o.voided = 0 GROUP BY o.person_id) inj ON inj.person_id = pat.patient_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o JOIN concept q ON q.concept_id = o.concept_id WHERE q.uuid = '668e0221-8b41-5669-9ad8-78e193d42494' AND o.voided = 0 AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL) rx ON rx.person_id = pat.patient_id WHERE pat.voided = 0 AND DATE(con.last_consult) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY) AND DATE(inj.last_injection) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 210 DAY)
message: Lost to follow-up: no data for 7 months
